day_local: Xuska Quduusiinta Kornelius, Baadari, iyo Sibriyan, Bishob, Shuhado
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Kiristoow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa.
homily:
Waxaa jira daqiiqado nolosha ah oo u muuqda kuwo aad u fudud, laakiin gudaha ka xambaarsan xikmad qoto dheer. Bal qiyaas wiil yar oo fadhiya miiskiisa, isagoo si taxaddar leh u dhisaya diyaarad model ah, ama isagoo koodhka kumbuyuutarka u qoraya si uu u abuuro wax cusub. Waa daqiiqado aamusnaan ah oo ay ka buuxdo ujeeddo. Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu waxyaabaha yaryar u rogo waxyaabo waaweyn. Ma aha oo kaliya farsamadiisa, laakiin xitaa riyooyinkiisa 'Con Chim Airlines' ee uu si qosol leh uga sheekayn jiray. Wuxuu ahaa wiil dhisayay aasaas adag, ma aha oo kaliya aqoontiisa, laakiin qalbigiisa.

Maanta, Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa ereyo aan marnaba lumin karin qiimahooda: 'Jacaylku waa samir, jacaylku waa naxariis.' Markaan eegno nolosha Benjamin, waxaan aragnaa in jacaylkani uusan ahayn fikrad keliya, laakiin uu ahaa qaab nololeed. Xusuusnow markuu ahaa 15 sano jir, ee uu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl aan sugin mahadcelin, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa.

Ciise wuxuu Injiilka maanta inoo sheegayaa: 'Waxaan idiin ciyaarnay durbaan, laakiin ma aydin qoob-ka-ciyaarin. Waxaan idiin heesnay baroor, laakiin ma aydin ooyin.' Ciise wuxuu ka hadlayaa qalbiyo adag oo aan awoodin inay arkaan xaqiiqda. Laakiin Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbigiisu u furnaa si uu u arko waxyaabaha aan la arki karin. Wuxuu arkayay quruxda, wuxuu arkayay baahida dadka kale, wuxuuna arkayay jacaylka Ilaah oo ku dhex jira adduunkan.

Alan iyo Thao, saddex bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale, June 13, 2026. Waxaan ogahay in gurigiina uu leeyahay aamusnaan aan la sharxi karin. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta idiin sheego si cad oo naxariis leh: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Waxaad Ben siiseen nolosha ugu quruxda badan ee waalid uu wiil siin karo. Jacaylkaaga, Alan, ee aad u sheegi jirtay sheekooyinka aad ku qosli jirteen, iyo taageeradaada, Thao, waxay ahaayeen nuurkii uu Ben ku koray. Waxaad ahaydeen waalidkii ugu fiicnaa. Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka uu Ben dareemay, iyo xanuunka aad hadda dareemaysaan, ma aha natiijada wax aad samayseen ama aad seegteen. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay xertiisa markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha, wuxuu yidhi: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Nolosha mararka qaarkood waxay leedahay duufaanno aan la saadaalin karin, laakiin aasaaska jacaylka aad Ben u qabteen waa mid aan la dumineyn.

Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in xitaa marka aqoontu ay dhammaato, jacaylku uu weli sii jiri doono. 'Jacaylku weligii ma fashilmo.' Ben wuxuu hadda ku jiraa 'Diyaafadda Jannada', isagoo qoslaya. Sida uu ku yidhi riyadii aad aragtay, 'Ba, ma aha wax dhib ah, waan ku daawanayaa.' Ben wuxuu doonayaa inaad sii waddo nolosha, inaad sii waddo riyada, inaad sii waddo inaad dhoolacaddayso.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay adiga kugu adkaayeen. Waxaad weyday walaalkaa, saaxiibkaa, iyo kii aad la wadaagi jirtay qolka iyo riyooyinka. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu yahay mid ku eegaya dhoolacaddayn. Sii wad inaad u noolaato si geesinimo leh, waayo xiriirka idinka dhexeeya ma go'in; wuxuu ku jiraa xiriirka quduuska ah ee salaadda. Sii wad inaad u noolaato si geesinimo leh, waayo Ben wuxuu doonayaa inaad faraxsan tahay.

Ceelka biyaha ee 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' ee Cà Mau waa calaamad muujinaysa in naxariistii Ben ay weli u qulqulayso sidii biyo nadiif ah oo kale, iyadoo quudinaysa dadka oomman. Magaciisa 'Đại Dương' oo macnaheedu yahay Badweyn Weyn wuxuu inoo xusuusinayaa in naxariista Ilaah ay ka ballaaran tahay murugo kasta. Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada kaliya markaad dhex joogto xanuunka. U dhiib shabaggaaga gacmaha Rabbiga. U ogolow Ciise inuu kula socdo. Benjamin, wiilkaygii qaaliga ahaa, noo ducee. Noo ducee annaga oo halkan joogna, si aan u helno xoog aan ku sii soconno, illaa aan mar kale kulanno oo aan aragno dhoolacaddayntaada quruxda badan albaabka Jannada. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaanan rabaa inaan kugu qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Sacrament-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sida adigoo hore u joogay, waxaana gebi ahaanba isu dhiibayaa adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin ilaaliyo, ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan intii dhimatay, ha ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, Rabbigu ha siiyo raaxo, xoog, iyo rajo weligeed ah.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, si xamaasad leh u raadiya hadiyadaha ruuxiga ah ee ugu waaweyn. Laakiin waxaan idin tusayaa waddo ka sii wanaagsan. Haddii aan ku hadlo afaf bini'aadam iyo malaa'igo, laakiin aanan lahayn jacayl, waxaan ahay sida gong dhawaaqaya ama sakaraad dhawaaqaya. Haddii aan leeyahay hadiyadda wax sii sheegidda, oo aan fahmo dhammaan waxyaalaha qarsoon iyo dhammaan aqoonta; haddii aan leeyahay dhammaan iimaanka si aan buuro u dhaqaajiyo, laakiin aanan lahayn jacayl, waxba ma ihi. Haddii aan bixiyo wax kasta oo aan haysto, oo aan jidhkayga u dhiibo si aan u faano, laakiin aanan lahayn jacayl, waxba kama faa'iido. Jacaylku waa samir, jacaylku waa naxariis. Ma maseero, jacaylku ma faano, iskuma kibriyo, ma aha mid anshax xun, ma raadsado danihiisa, si fudud uma xanaaqo, kama fikiro xumaanta, kuma farxo xaqdarro, laakiin wuxuu ku farxaa runta. Wuxuu u dulqaataa wax walba, wuxuu rumaystaa wax walba, wuxuu rajeeyaa wax walba, wuxuuna adkaystaa wax walba. Jacaylku weligii ma fashilmo. Haddii ay jiraan wax sii sheegid, waa la baabi'in doonaa; haddii ay jiraan afaf, way dhammaan doonaan; haddii ay jirto aqoon, waa la baabi'in doonaa. Waayo, qayb ahaan ayaannu wax u naqaannaa, qayb ahaanna wax u sii sheegnaa, laakiin marka kan dhammaystirani yimaado, qaybta waa la baabi'in doonaa. Markii aan ilmo ahaa, waxaan u hadli jiray sidii ilmo, waxaan u fikiri jiray sidii ilmo, waxaan u sababayn jiray sidii ilmo; markii aan nin noqday, waxaan iska fogeeyay waxyaalihii ilmanimada. Hadda waxaan aragnaa si aan caddayn, sida muraayad, laakiin markaas waxaan arki doonnaa waji ka waji. Hadda waxaan aqaan qayb ahaan; markaas ayaan si buuxda u ogaan doonaa, sida aan aniga si buuxda u ogaaday. Sidaas darteed, iimaanka, rajada, iyo jacaylku way sii jiraan, saddexdan; laakiin kan ugu weyn waa jacaylka.

readings.label: Sabuurka Jawaabta
readings.text: R. (12) Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa. Ku mahadnaqa Rabbiga kataaradda; toban xadhig leh oo kataarad ah ku ammaana. U heesa hees cusub; xadhkaha si xirfad leh u jiida, adigoo ku dhawaaqaya farxad. R. Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa. Waayo ereyga Rabbigu waa toosan yahay, dhammaan shuqulladiisuna waa la aamini karaa. Wuxuu jecel yahay caddaaladda iyo xaqa; dunidu waxay ka buuxdaa naxariista Rabbiga. R. Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa. Barakaysan qaranka uu Ilaahiisu yahay Rabbiga, dadka uu u doortay dhaxalkiisa. Naxariistaada, Rabbiyow, ha dul joogto annaga oo rajadeenna kugu dhex dhigtay. R. Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu dadkii badnaa ku yidhi: 'Maxaan u barbardhigaa dadka jiilkan? Maxay u eg yihiin? Waxay u eg yihiin carruur suuqa fadhiya oo isugu yeedhaya, "Waxaan idiin garaacnay durbaan, laakiin ma aydin qoob-ka-ciyaarin. Waxaan idiin heesnay baroor, laakiin ma aydin ooyin." Waayo, Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha wuxuu u yimid isagoon cunin cunto iyo cabbin khamri, oo waxaad tidhi, "Wuxuu qabaa jinni." Wiilka Aadanaha wuxuu u yimid isagoo wax cunaya oo cabbaya, oo waxaad tidhi, "Bal eega, waa qof cunto badan oo khamri cabba, saaxiibna la ah canshuur-qaadayaasha iyo dembiilayaasha." Laakiin xigmadda waxaa xaqiijiyay dhammaan carruurteeda.'

day: Memorial of Saints Cornelius, Pope, and Cyprian, Bishop, Martyrs

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.
